verdict.rationale: Adyen exposes reporting/dashboards for balances, sales, and payouts (adyen-docs-10, adyen-docs-12) and an MCP server enabling LLM-driven interaction with its APIs (adyen-docs-5, adyen-probe-4), suggesting an agent could in principle pull payout/transaction data. However, there's no explicit evidence of a dedicated balance-transaction/payout reconciliation API or documented workflow for matching bank deposits to underlying charges, and community feedback repeatedly flags Adyen's integration as complex and 'bare metal' (adyen-comm-5, adyen-comm-9).
